messages:
Jules: Hey all, first-day question — I can SSH to the bastion but can't reach internal docs at 10.5.2.8:8000 from WSL. Running Win11 corp image + WSL2. Any tips?

Priya (eng-infra): Welcome Jules! Most common: WSL2 doesn't pick up Windows VPN routes. Does `ipconfig` show a 10.5.0.0/16 route under the VPN adapter?

Jules: Yes, Windows shows 10.5.0.0/16 via the VPN. In WSL `ip route` only shows default via 172.28.112.1.

Infra Bot: vpn-service: user Jules connected. Routes pushed: 10.5.0.0/16 -> vpn0.

Priya (eng-infra): Quick try: `wsl --shutdown` then reopen your distro to let it re-init network. If that doesn't work run `sudo ip route add 10.5.0.0/16 via 172.28.112.1` inside WSL (replace gateway if different). We also have `wsl-route-sync` helper in infra tools (internal link in docs).

Jules: Did the shutdown trick — routes appeared and I can curl the docs host now. Thanks!

Priya (eng-infra): Awesome. I'll add a short note to the onboarding checklist: Win11 + WSL2 route sync after VPN connect. Ping #eng-infra if it recurs.

Jules: Saved my morning, appreciate it :smile:
